# Le030 — `\PE\` selector and `\Q\x` directive support

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

**Section**: §12.1a (`12-1a-encoding`)  
**Fixture**: [`step-examples/12-1a-encoding/Le030.stp`](../../step-examples/12-1a-encoding/Le030.stp)  

## Sources
- S003/SFA-User-Guide-v7 Fig. 90 (`\PE\`, `\Q\x`)

## Description

ISO 10303-21 also defines `\PE\` (UCS extended) and `\Q\x` (alternate-quote) directives that some legacy generators emit. Few parsers implement these, so the bytes pass through to the user as literal `\PE\` or `\Q'`.

## Reproducer recipe

`'\PE\foo'`; `'\Q\'foo\Q\'`

## Expected kernel behavior

at minimum, recognise the directives and consume the documented number of operands without lexer desynchronisation; warn if decoding is not fully implemented.
